name: Cloud / Shared-Resource Cost Governance (standing)
description: Andrew-direct greenlight 2026-06-03 (relayed via 0.6.0). NEW MACRO. Standing governance for cloud/shared-resource cost: attribution, fleet telemetry coverage, right-sizing methodology, runner lifecycle/hygiene, cadence+ownership. Origin = 0.7.0_AE_CloudOps May cloud-cost forensics (May spend $602; EC2-Compute 59%; bd-gold-layer-runner c6i.16xlarge = 34% of bill, CPU provisioned for rare parallel bursts but RAM ~99% idle; telemetry partial; attribution structurally blocked w/o tags+CUR; hygiene gaps EBS orphans/8x stopped backfill fleet/QA runner GOLD_KEEP_ALIVE=1). Brief = docs/briefs/nfra-cloud-cost-governance-prd-request-20260601.md. ANDREW COMPUTE-DISCIPLINE CONSTRAINT (binds all workstreams): do NOT trigger ad-hoc gold runs to validate telemetry/right-sizing/profiles -- validate on the SCHEDULED nightly runs only. Any 'prove the telemetry / capture the profile' AC = next scheduled run, never a manufactured one.
